title: On the uniqueness of the critical point of $ψ_Ω$
summary: We prove that for any bounded convex domain $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^n$, the function \begin{equation*} ψ_Ω(ξ) = \int_{\mathbb{R}^n\setminusΩ} \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{|x-ξ|^{2n}}, \quad ξ\inΩ, \end{equation*} has exactly one critical point. This confirms an conjecture proposed by Clapp, Pistoia and Saldaña in [J. Math. Pures Appl. 205 (2026), 103783]. The proof uses a spherical coordinates representation to write $ψ_Ω$ as an integral of the distance function $ρ(ξ,ω)$. This approach is not limited to $ψ_Ω$.
